Who we are  Xempus is the leading European group pension, life and health insurance platform. We seamlessly connect insurers, insurance agents, corporates and their systems in an automated and customer-centric manner. jobs.title: Language Lead - French (Contract)
jobs.description:
About Cartesia

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.  We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.  We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

Overview

We are seeking native-level French speakers with a linguistics background to serve as the primary language resource for voice AI in their language. You will be the trusted point of contact for all questions, quality decisions, and language-specific work related to French.  This is not a standard annotation engagement. You will own your language end to end, which includes managing annotation quality, auditing data, monitoring product performance, investigating customer-reported issues, and executing projects that require deep linguistic expertise and attention to detail. You will operate independently across these workstreams and serve as the team's go-to resource for anything related to your language.  This is an ongoing contractor engagement. Availability during some US Pacific business hours is preferred to allow for team syncs and real-time support.

About the Engagement

You will coordinate with the Human Evals Manager on project deliverables and timelines. Some examples of what your day-to-day work may include:

Answer questions from annotators about guidelines, edge cases, or language-specific issues via an agreed project communication channel.

Cascade new feedback, instructions, or rubric updates to annotators working on your projects.

Listen to annotator-rated audio files and check whether their ratings and written feedback align with the rubric.

Prepare written quality assessments for annotators with specific examples and recommendations.

Listen to TTS output and provide ground truth assessments of pronunciation, prosody, and naturalness in your language.

Update or expand sections of the annotation guidelines when you find gaps or edge cases.

Prep and run calibration meetings with annotators.

Hold office hours on a mutually agreed schedule during active studies so annotators can ask questions in real time.

Develop onboarding materials and resources for new annotators.

Write QA reports on annotation quality and calibration outcomes.

Review production audio in your language and flag quality issues to the team.

Investigate language-specific issues reported by customers and i

jobs.title: Account Manager - Groceries & Retail
jobs.description:
Pourquoi Deliveroo ?

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous donnons à chaque personne la possibilité d'acheter ce qu'elles veulent, comme elles le veulent, quand elles le veulent et où elles le veulent.  Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d’un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

En tant qu'Account Manager ,  vous serez responsable du succès de votre portefeuille de comptes , afin d’assurer une expérience magique à nos utilisateurs, tout en construisant un socle solide et durable pour notre application.

MISSIONS :

Votre objectif sera de créer un partenariat privilégié, durable en apportant votre expertise marketplace, foodtech et account management.

Vous aurez comme missions principales la gestion et l’optimisation de la croissance et la profitabilité d’un portefeuille de partenaires et le respect des objectifs fixés (opérationnels et commerciaux, ventes de services)

Vous développerez des joint business plans avec les principaux acteurs de votre portefeuille en vous appuyant sur des routines (price, range, roll out, ops, tech review) pour faire croître le partenariat des comptes de votre équipe.

Vous serez en charge du déploiement et de l’expansion de votre portefeuille ainsi que des différentes campagnes Marketing que vous devrez négocier dans le cadre du “joint business plan”.

Analyse quotidienne de la data de la performance des marques et de nos opérations Deliveroo pour identifier les causes des problèmes et améliorer constamment le niveau de service.

Optimisation et gestion de processus : Deliveroo est une société qui évolue à grande vitesse et à grande échelle. Vous aurez l’opportunité de créer et améliorer des processus, par exemple la gestion de partenariats pour contribuer à la croissance. Vous élaborerez des outils et des guides de meilleures pratiques pour des comptes spécifiques et pour l'ensemble du portefeuille.

Vous veillerez au suivi du respect des engagements contractuels pris avec les partenaires de votre portefeuille.

PROFIL :

jobs.title: Knit - Research Manager
jobs.description:
Knit

is the AI-native consumer research platform helping brands automate and accelerate primary research. With our Researcher-Driven AI, we’ve condensed the entire quant + qual research process from weeks into days (sometimes hours!) for 50+ enterprise brands — including Amazon, T-Mobile, Mars, NASCAR, and more. We’re on a mission to scale and democratize world-class research. From survey generation to stakeholder-ready reports, our platform is redefining how insights teams operate — and we need your help to push the limits of what’s possible.

Overview

The purpose of the Research Manager role is to ensure Knit customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their partnerships with Knit. By owning and supporting customer relationships, getting deeply engrained in customer research needs, and driving high-quality project deliverables, the Research Manager’s impact is ultimately measured by positive customer retention.

Responsibilities:

The research function is a primary contributor to Knit’s shared business objectives of customer retention and upsells, ultimately measured by Net Revenue Retention (NRR) in addition to supporting successful Pilot to Subscription Conversions for acquiring new business.

The levers the Research Manager role owns to influence these key business objectives are:

Research Success → Ensuring Knit Customers successfully achieve their desired research outcomes through their projects with Knit, measured by successfully achieving Research Objectives and delivering on Knit’s Quality & Speed service-level agreements (SLA’s)

Primary responsibilities of this role:

Serving as the dedicated research lead for all customers’ projects (on assigned accounts) and serving as the ultimate accountable part for research project success

Driving and documenting in-depth project scoping to uncover a deep understanding of research objectives and project context to set up project success

Demonstrate a growth mindset as a solutions architect for customers, educating them on Knit’s research capabilities, consulting with them to adjust for fringe requirements, and proposing solutions to maximize project success - escalating to Research Directors when needs exceed capabilities

Escalating needs to Research Directors to support troubleshooting when increased risk for project viability or customer impact occurs

Driving, maintaining, and enriching all customer context to improve Knit’s ability to meet the customers’ custom research needs

Being the final, customer-ready check and approver on all Knit final topline delivery and presenting the key insights and recommendations directly to the customers

Participating in continuous innovation on Knit’s AI product to minimize the delta between Knit’s AI output and a human researcher output

Driving on feedback collection on “the last mile” - uncovering and documenting what happens after Knit delivers a project to when it’s “stakeholder ready,” supporting Knit’s product vision

Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next

Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger

Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility.

This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world.

Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL)

Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights

Your Team and Role

Working on the Privacy Functional Team, you'll lead complex projects across key company-wide objectives. You'll protect the privacy of our users using Go, Node.js, Python, and (sometimes) Perl to write pragmatic, performant, testable code, and work on related projects. Potential projects include:

In time, you'll formally mentor other engineers, supporting their career growth and the growth of the Privacy Team at DuckDuckGo.

Published research at A* venues on automated red-teaming, agent

C’est pourquoi nous accompagnons les plus grands acteurs de la finance, de l’industrie et de la tech sur leurs projets les plus stratégiques en Data Science, Machine Learning et Intelligence Artificielle.

Vos missions

Nous recherchons un Senior Data Engineer pour participer à la construction d’une plateforme Data développée from scratch, destinée à des équipes travaillant sur des problématiques de recherche et de calcul intensif.

L’objectif de cette plateforme est de gérer l’ensemble du cycle de vie des données : ingestion, traitements distribués, backtesting à grande échelle et mise à disposition des données pour des usages de recherche et de production.

L’un des enjeux techniques majeurs du projet concerne le calcul distribué et l’intégration de Spark au cœur de l’architecture de la plateforme.

Dans ce contexte, vous interviendrez notamment sur :

le développement des composants de calcul distribué,

la conception et l’optimisation de pipelines de données à forte volumétrie,

les problématiques de performance et de scalabilité liées aux traitements massifs,

l’évolution de l’architecture Data,

la qualité et la maintenabilité du code Python utilisé en production.

Pourquoi rejoindre la practice ?

Vous rejoindrez une practice en pleine construction, portée par une forte ambition technologique autour des infrastructures cloud, des plateformes data et des systèmes distribués.

L’objectif n’est pas simplement d’accompagner des projets, mais de construire une communauté d’ingénieurs capables d’intervenir sur des sujets techniques exigeants : architecture cloud, calcul distribué, plateformes data, performance et scalabilité.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où l’autonomie, la profondeur technique et la capacité à prendre des responsabilités sont valorisées dès le départ.

Profil recherché

Vous maîtrisez Python et accordez une attention particulière à la qualité du code et à la conception logicielle

Vous possédez une compréhension approfondie de Spark et des problématiques réelles de calcul distribué

Vous avez déjà travaillé sur des systèmes à forte volumétrie ou à fortes contraintes de performance

Vous êtes à l’aise dans des environnements cloud modernes

Des missions ambitieuses et variées, toujours sélectionnées pour leur valeur ajoutée ;

Un accompagnement de proximité par des experts reconnus ;

Une communauté d’ingénieurs passionnés, avec workshops, conférences et échanges réguliers ;

Une culture d’exigence technique, de partage des connaissances et de développement continu.

Pourquoi rejoindre la practice IA ?

Vous évoluerez au sein d’une équipe encadrée par Hamza Bouanani, Practice Manager IA chez MARGO, également Lead Data Scientist chez BNP Paribas.

Travailler à ses côtés, c’est intégrer une équipe d’experts passionnés, être challengé sur le plan technique et méthodologique, et contribuer à des projets à fort impact pour les clients.

Vos missions

Nous recherchons un

Machine Learning Engineer

pour rejoindre nos équipes et intervenir au cœur de la stratégie Data de nos clients (Industrie, Finance, Énergie). Votre objectif principal sera d'industrialiser les algorithmes de Machine Learning et de garantir leur cycle de vie en production.

Vous interviendrez sur trois axes techniques majeurs :

1. Industrialisation & Déploiement (Model Serving)

- Transformation des modèles de recherche (Proof of Concept) en code de production robuste, testé et optimisé.

- Développement d'APIs performantes (FastAPI, Flask) pour exposer les modèles aux applications métiers.

- Conteneurisation des solutions (Docker) et orchestration sur des clusters (Kubernetes) pour assurer la scalabilité et la haute disponibilité.

- Gestion du versioning des données et des modèles (DVC, MLflow) pour assurer la reproductibilité des expériences.

3. Performance & Optimisation

- Optimisation des temps de réponse (latence) et de l'utilisation des ressources de calcul (CPU/GPU).

- Refactoring de code pour respecter les standards de Software Craftsmanship (Clean Code, TDD).

- Gestion des Feature Stores pour centraliser et servir les variables calculées en temps réel.

Monitoring avancé :

Mise en place de sondes pour détecter le "Data Drift" (dérive des données) ou le "Model Drift" et déclencher des alertes proactives.

Faire le pont entre les Data Scientists (mathématiques/modélisation) et les Data Engineers (infrastructure/données) pour fluidifier les mises en production.

Évangélisation :

Diffuser les bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel au sein des équipes Data Science.

jobs.description:
At

Genomines  , our mission is to pioneer a new era of sustainable metal production by farming plants that hyperaccumulate metal. Through synthetic biology and cutting-edge technology, we harness the power of nature to create plants that can farm for metals while decontaminating soils and creating cleaner lands for agriculture. Our ultimate goal is to become the world's first carbon-negative nickel producer, using sustainable, eco-friendly methods to extract the valuable resources our society needs for the energy transition.

We are backed by

Engine Ventures  ,

Lowercarbon Capital  ,

Forbion BioEconomy  ,

Wind

and

DTCF

and have recently closed a

$45M Series A  . With proof-of-concept partnerships already in place (Hyundai Motor Group, Jaguar Land Rover and various battery value chain players), Genomines is now moving from R&D into commercial scale-up, launching initial projects and expanding globally, with early deployments in South Africa.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Genomines is seeking an entrepreneurial Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) to design and lead its global commercial strategy at the nexus of industrial biotechnology, agriculture, and critical minerals. This role offers the opportunity to shape how cutting-edge biotechnology redefines critical mineral supply chains for the energy transition. The CCO will translate technical breakthroughs into clear, actionable value propositions for customers, partners, and policymakers, advancing existing relationships across the value chain and turning them into meaningful commercial traction. Over time, this role will guide Genomines from its first field assets to scaled deployment, establishing a multi-metal, multi-country, multi-model revenue platform.

The CCO will own commercial prioritization, monetization pathways, and market-facing risk decisions in close partnership with the CEO and the leadership team. The CCO will architect the commercial roadmap that takes Genomines from first field assets to a scaled, multi-metal, multi-country platform.

Success in this role will be measured by the conversion of early partnerships and agreements into long-term offtake and commercial agreements, the timely ramp-up of revenue across initial assets, successful entry into priority geographies and metals, and the establishment of repeatable, scalable commercial models aligned with Genomines’ growth trajectory.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

COMMERCIAL STRATEGY:  Define and execute a global roadmap for nickel-first deployment, expanding to cobalt, rare earths, and other metals. Develop scalable business models, ranging from direct metal sales and joint ventures to licensing and asset-light structures.

CUSTOMER PARTNERSHIPS : Convert early MOUs and offtake discussions into long-term contracts while building trusted, high-impact relationships with OEMs, refiners, landowners, and battery materials partners. Establish Genomines as a respected category player in global mineral supply chains.

jobs.title: Data Governance Lead (São Paulo, Brasil)
jobs.description:
Please Note: B Lab is not working with a third party to fill this role an no part of our process requires applicants to pay fees. Applicants should only use our job board to submit an application, and will interact directly with our team during this process.

This is a Full-Time Role (40 hours per week, 5 days per week) with no option for part-time work. While this is a remote-first opportunity, the candidate filling this role must be a resident of the Netherlands, the U.K. or Brazil at the start of employment. Additionally, they must be within commuting distance of our office in Amsterdam, London, or São Paulo.
Please visit our Careers page to review all opportunities and submit your application for the role(s) that best fit your location and work authorization.

About the Role

The Data & AI team is responsible for building B Lab's data platform, delivering on business priorities, and scaling AI adoption across the organization. The team reports directly to the CTDO. The Data & ML Platforms team owns the data platform, ML infrastructure, and the foundational data models the rest of the Data & AI team depends on — the supply-side capability layer that Business & Data Priorities and AI Enablement build on.

As the Data Governance Lead on the Data & ML Platforms pillar, you own data standards, definitions, and sensitivity classification across B Lab's data platform, and ensure the platform and its analytics comply with relevant laws and documentation requirements. Beyond governance, you play a growing role in building data literacy across the organization — helping teams understand and trust the data available to them, and ensuring definitions and standards are actually adopted, not just documented. You work closely with the Senior Analytics Engineer and Data Engineer to make sure new models and pipelines are built to standard from the start.

Core Responsibilities

Data Standards & Governance (35%):

  • Own Data Standards & Definitions: Establish and maintain the organization's data standards, definitions, and sensitivity classifications.

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
We're Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.  Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world's healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.  We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.  If you don't choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself then, choose the challenge, choose Heidi.

The role

Heidi's UK and Europe business is growing faster than the finance scaffolding underneath it. Central finance across Sydney, Melbourne and Manila runs month-end close, core accounting and day-to-day operations, but the region needs someone on the ground who owns the accuracy of its numbers and sits close enough to the commercial team to shape decisions before they get made. Today, regional leaders wait on Australian hours for answers about their own P&L. You'll end that.

The role has two halves and both carry equal weight. You'll own regional financial control and compliance: the integrity of the balance sheet, the accuracy of management reporting and forecasts, cash, strong local controls, and statutory obligations across Companies House, HMRC and VAT, directed through external advisers. You'll also be a hands-on business partner to UK and Europe leadership, Sales and Customer Success, owning the P&L narrative, bringing a commercial view to pricing, deal terms and customer economics, and making sure teams see the financial consequence of the choices they make. You'll report to the Group Financial Controller with a dotted line to FP&A.

What you'll do

Financial reporting and month-end close

Own the integrity of the UK&Europe balance sheet, with reconciliations that stay current, reviewed and explainable

Own the accuracy of the UK&Europe monthly group reporting and management accounts with variance commentary that explains movements

Be the single point of contact for group finance on anything UK&Europe: queries, adjustments, restatements, consolidation-level questions

Compliance and risk oversight

Own the UK&Europe compliance calendar (Companies House, HMRC, VAT) by directing external accountants and advisers

Own the adviser relationships (accounting, tax, audit), keeping work well scoped, reviewed and connected back to Heidi's internal finance standards

Build an early-warning process so compliance risk is caught and escalated well before it threatens trading status

jobs.title: Global Director of Logistics & Fulfilment
jobs.description:
More than one third of the food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste!

At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: To inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. We are the world's #1 app for fighting food waste and we work with thousands of restaurants and food retailers to make their surplus food available to local consumers. The magic of Too Good To Go has expanded rapidly across Europe, the US, and Canada, with over 500 million meals saved across our 20 countries to date.

We’re proud of what we’ve achieved so far, but did we mention the issue is huge? We always want to raise the bar and that’s where you come in.

Your mission at Too Good to Go…

We’re looking for an exceptional Global Director of Logistics & Fulfillment to lead the end-to-end logistics and fulfillment engine behind Parcels across transportation, warehousing, repack, pick/pack, and last-mile delivery. This is a strategic role with a highly operational core: you’ll define the global fulfillment strategy, build the partner ecosystem, and drive the day-to-day performance and continuous improvement needed to scale reliably in an agile, high-growth environment.

You will report to the VP Operations, Parcels and sit on the Global Parcels Leadership Team, leading a global organization of 15+ team members across 10+ countries.

Our Parcels business is a transformative solution that enables food manufacturers to effectively reduce food waste while extracting value from surplus food. Through direct purchasing from food manufacturers, Too Good To Go carefully curates and assembles the purchased products into bundles, which are then offered to our users at a discount of ~50% off of original retail. Sold through our existing Too Good To Go app, customers can opt to have their orders conveniently delivered to their doorstep or pick it up from a nearby location. Instead of allowing these products to go to waste, manufacturers decrease their environmental impact, optimise their revenue by maximising the value of saved food, and enhance product visibility in the market.

In the role, you will:

Build and scale a best-in-class fulfillment network (strategy + execution)

  • Own and optimize the full Parcels logistics value chain: inbound to warehouse, repack/kitting, inventory management, pick/pack, carrier handoff, last-mile delivery, and returns/claims.
  • Architect and execute a logistics and fulfillment strategy that supports cost efficiency, service quality, and international growth.
  • Operate comfortably in ambiguity: create structure fast, make trade-offs, and iterate as we scale.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineers turn what Luma's models can do into systems customers actually rely on. You embed with a customer, learn their workflow, define the problem with them, and build the production system that solves it, with their data and their constraints. You own both the relationship and the code.  This is engineering at the edge, where ambiguity is the default and "what should we build?" is yours to answer. It's built for people who've already been the single point of ownership on a hard problem: a technical founder, the engineer who flew out and rebuilt a customer's workflow, a consultant who actually wrote the system. If you need a PRD and a well-defined ticket queue, this isn't it.

What You'll Own

Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, constraints, and goals, and define the problem yourself.

Build production systems on Luma's APIs, models, and internal tools.

Prototype, ship, iterate, and maintain systems customers depend on in real environments with real data.

Own projects end to end, from first conversation to deployed system.

Build around platform gaps when something's missing, and feed recurring patterns back to platform and R&D to productize.

Use AI to accelerate implementation, while the core of the work stays engineering judgment: what to build and how to make it reliable.

First 90 Days

One way the first 90 could unfold.

Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose:  Embed with a first customer, learn their workflow, and define the real problem.

Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate:  Build and deploy a production system they actually use.

Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize:  Spot the pattern worth productizing and work with R&D to turn it into platform.

What You Bring

2+ years of professional software engineering, with software shipped end to end.

Strong proficiency in at least one general-purpose language (Python, TypeScript, Go, or similar).

Ability to work across the stack and learn unfamiliar systems quickly.

Bachelor's in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

Willingness to travel to client sites as needed.

Nice to Have

A track record of shipping real systems with real users, not just assigned tasks.

High agency and strong prioritization: you find the core problem and move.

Comfort defining your own path when there isn't one.

Evidence of working directly with customers and translating what you heard into what you built.

Clear communication, including explaining a technical decision to a non-technical stakeholder.

The sea is the physical layer of the economy—the conduit for our energy, communications, and trade. It is also Europe’s exposed flank. Pelagon is building the answer. It will be deployed on a distributed, autonomous network of vectors (UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys, seabed…) to provide real-time understanding of underwater threats.  France and Europe have world-class acoustic engineers and a long history in underwater warfare. By bridging this expertise with modern physical-AI strategies (as seen in autonomous driving and robotics). Everything that moves beneath the surface leaves an acoustic trace, but the ocean is a brutal channel: multipath, ambient noise, shifting propagation. Reading it is first and foremost a physics problem.  France and Europe have a world-class heritage in underwater acoustics and sonar. Pelagon's bet is to bridge that science with modern physical-AI strategies and a distributed fleet of UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys and seabed sensors. As our  Acoustic Researcher , you are the physics backbone of that system — the person who understands underwater sound deeply enough that our models can learn from it. You partner directly with our AI Engineers, who consume the features, representations and data you help define.

Model underwater sound propagation across realistic ocean environments to enable our synthetic data generation pipeline.

Design and reason about sensor and array geometries: what to deploy, where, and how to extract maximum information from constrained & distributed vectors.

Work hand in hand with AI Engineers on physics-constrained learning strategies ans models.

What we look for

Deep grounding in underwater acoustics, sonar, or a closely related field (ocean acoustics, radar/array processing, acoustic signal processing). PhD or equivalent research experience.

Strong command of statistical signal processing: detection & estimation theo

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Engine DataModel team, you will own and innovate on the foundational components that form the backbone of the Roblox platform. In the Roblox Engine, the DataModel is a tree-like structure that is analogous to a scenegraph in other 3D engines. This role will report to the engineering manager and will be based out of our HQ in San Mateo, CA in a hybrid model 3 days a week (Tuesdays to Thursdays).

Our team owns:

  • The core structures and systems are used to build the DataModel and interact with it.
  • The C++ reflection bindings that form the Engine’s Luau API surface and let creators interact with the DataModel. We’ve built custom codegen tooling to generate the C++ for these reflection bindings and other related structures.
  • DataModel serialization … and much more!

You will:

  • Develop engine code that performs well for all user-created games on the Roblox platform.
  • Build the core systems and data structures used in the Roblox engine, working with other teams to find universal solutions.
  • Take ownership of projects throughout their full lifecycles.
  • Execute code that performs well on all the devices Roblox supports—from desktop clients to mobile phone clients to console clients.

You have:

  • Experience developing outstanding systems-level C++ programming.
  • Have experience working on game engine internals
  • Responsibility for building and maintaining systems that work optimally.
  • Curiosity to learn and stay up-to-date on technology developments.
  • Have a curiosity about the actual work the CPU does when you use smart pointers, templates, virtual functions, and blocks of memory, both structured and raw.

The Game Engine team at Roblox works on the systems that power the experiences at the heart of the metaverse. Our code is the technical foundation in our client, editor, and our simulation servers.

The Game Engine team is broadly split into departments — Audio-Video-Communication, Avatar, Core AI, Digital Matter, Productivity, and Systems. This position is for the Systems Runtime pod.

The Runtime pod builds and maintains the foundational C++ components that power the entire Roblox engine and Studio stack. We own the runtime layer — the performance, efficiency, and usability of the core primitives that every other engineering team relies on. Think of Runtime as the “standard library” and execution engine for Roblox's C++ world. Our ownership centers on three pillars:

  • Concurrency System — our task scheduler and fiber runtime power how work is parallelized across CPU cores, letting teams scale features across platforms while keeping code understandable and debuggable.
  • Memory System — we own the engine's memory allocator stack, tracking pipelines, and observability tooling to make memory behavior predictable and prevent leaks and fragmentation.
  • Profiling and Observability — we build and evolve the MicroProfiler and telemetry pipelines to help engineers diagnose real-world regressions and keep the client fast at global scale.

This role centers on our Concurrency system. You will own the scheduler and fiber runtime that the rest of the engine is built on, research and implement the performance work needed for 3K-player servers and genre expansion initiatives, and act as the point of contact other engine teams come to with concurrency asks. You will debug real production failures across PC, Mac, mobile, and console, and build deep intuition for how compilers, CPU architectures, and operating systems interact. A single well-designed primitive or optimization here makes hundreds of internal engineer

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (m/w/d) | Fullstack für KI-Produkte
jobs.description:
Über uns  Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!

Das gibt es zu tun

Architektur & Umsetzung  Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt.

KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten  Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen.

Full-Stack liefern  Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche.

Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit  Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit.

Betrieb & Observability mitdenken  Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft.

Komplexität beherrschen  Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind.

AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen  Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen.

Team & Produkt weiterbringen  Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter.

Das bringst Du mit

Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme, idealerweise im KI- bzw. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld  Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS

Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices

Peerspace  · Customer Experience · Entry level

Peerspace is the leading and category defining online marketplace for venue rentals for meetings, productions, and events. We open doors to the most inspiring spaces around the world, from lofts and mansions to storefronts and studios. Most routine questions get answered before they ever reach a person. What's left are the conversations that actually need one: a host and a guest who remember the same booking differently, a photographer whose shoot starts in three hours and the space just fell through, a situation where we don’t have a policy in place to resolve.

Look for chances to surprise and delight someone, and take them.

Flag recurring issues, confusing policies, and product friction to Specialists and leadership so they get fixed rather than re-answered.

Hit response-time and quality targets while keeping careful, complete case notes.

Show up for your team: standups, Slack etc… be a part of the culture that makes this a stellar place to work.

You lead with empathy and keep the customer's interest front and center, even when the answer is no. You write clearly and warmly, and you care about grammar and tone. jobs.location: London, UK; Ontario, CAN; Remote-Friendly, United States; San Francisco, CA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic Fellows Program overview

The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience.

Fellows will primarily use external infrastructure (e.g. open-source models, public APIs) to work on project aligned with our research priorities, with the goal of producing a public output (e.g. a paper submission). In one of our earlier cohorts, over 80% of fellows produced papers. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis.

This page is specific to one of the Anthropic Fellows workstreams; see also the main Anthropic Fellows posting.

Submit your application to the Economics & Policy workstream at the bottom of this page. We are accepting applications on a rolling basis for the next cohort expected to start in January 2027. In some circumstances, we can accommodate fellows starting outside the usual cohort timelines — please note in your application if the January 2027 start date doesn't work for you.

What to expect

  • 4 months of full-time research
  • Direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers
  • Access to a shared workspace (in either Berkeley, California or London, UK)
  • Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community
  • Weekly stipend of 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD + benefits (these vary by country)
  • Funding for compute (~$15k/month) and other research expenses

Interview process

The interview process will include an initial application & reference check, assessments & interviews, and a research discussion.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. Graphcore is building the hardware and systems infrastructure needed for the next generation of AI breakthroughs. This role helps prove those platforms work when complexity, scale and pressure increase.

You will lead advanced operational, diagnostic and engineering support across lab and data centre environments. Your work will improve hardware bring-up, validation and troubleshooting for AI compute platforms.

· Strong knowledge of server hardware architectures and board-level debugging

· Confidence working across engineering, platform and data centre teams

Company Overview

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

jobs.title: Senior Avionics System Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building innovative aerospace technologies that advance the future of space transportation.  We are looking for an  Avionics Systems Engineer  to support the design, development, integration, and validation of spacecraft avionics systems. The role focuses on delivering robust and reliable electronic systems for data handling, communications, and control across all mission phases.  The engineer will contribute to system architecture definition, interface management, verification activities, and requirements engineering, while working closely with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders. In this role, you might be assigned to different avionics systems of the spacecraft.

Key Responsibilities  System Design & Architecture

Define and develop  avionics system architectures , including electronics, data handling, and communication functions.

Ensure end-to-end consistency of  data flows, interfaces, and system-level requirements .

Support selection and definition of avionics equipment, computing platforms, sensors, and communication hardware.

Contribute to spacecraft-level trade-offs between performance, reliability, mass, power, and cost.

Communications & Data Handling

Define onboard and ground-related  communication and data handling concepts .

Support implementation of telemetry, telecommand, and data distribution architectures.

Ensure reliable  data acquisition, processing, storage, and transmission  under mission constraints.

Contribute to bandwidth, timing, and data budget analyses.

Integration & Interface Management

Define and manage interfaces between avionics and other spacecraft subsystems (power, propulsion, GNC, payload, etc.).

Ensure compatibility between spacecraft, launch vehicle, and ground segment interfaces.

Coordinate interface definitions with internal teams, suppliers, and external stakeholders.

External Regulatory & Certification Leadership  Strong ability to technically present, defend, and substantiate avionics subsystem designs and verification evidence with external regulatory and certification authorities, including NASA, ESA, and other government agencies, supporting spacecraft qualification, safety, and flight certification.  Verification & Validation

Define and support  verification and validation strategies  for avionics systems.

Participate in simulation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), and system-level testing activities.

Analyze test results, identify anomalies, and drive corrective actions.

Ensure compliance with system performance and reliability requirements.

Requirements Engineering

Capture, analyze, and manage  system and subsystem requirements .

Ensure full traceability from mission objectives to implementation and validation.

Contribute to system documentation, including specifications, interface control documents, and test plans.

Ensure compliance with applicable space standards and engineering best practices.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Ownership, drive, structured thinking, and the ability to thrive in ambiguity and open ended problems. You take problems personally, decide in the absence of a clear roadmap, and own the outcome including the downside.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager, Foundry

At Instructure , we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:  Foundry is a new division inside Instructure, built to generate new revenue with AI-built products. We operate as a portfolio of small pods, each charged with one product bet, under tight weekly governance. They operate independently, with dedicated resources, separate from the core business on purpose: different pace, different governance, and different rewards.  Our goal is to generate meaningful revenue within 12 to 18 months, so this isn’t an innovation lab. We’re building scaled businesses that customers pay for and retain well, and we’re measuring ourselves on revenue, not activity. A pod is two people: a Founder and a Builder, both hands on, close to the customer. The bet is deliberate: we invest in agent-developer tooling and tokens, not in headcount. An operating team of growth marketing, revenue operations, sales overlay, and G&A supports every pod, so founders stay on building products.  Every pod inherits an underlying platform with common design, development, and deployment harnesses, so no pod rebuilds the plumbing. Each pod runs through key phases with regular checkpoints where a governing board reviews progress or recommends a pivot or kill.  The rhythm is fast and transparent. Investor-style updates go out weekly. Demos and keep-or-kill checkpoints happen twice a month. Transparency is the operating model.

What you will do

You’re the operational engine behind New Markets’ newest product bets. You’ll own the end-to-end go-to-market lifecycle for pod products, from market sizing and early strategy through launch, performance tracking, and the handoff when a product graduates into the core. When a pod proves customers will pay, you make that motion repeatable and hand it to the full seller base. This is a blank-page job: the playbook doesn’t exist yet, and you’ll write it. The role reports directly to the President, New Markets, with a matrixed dotted line to Instructure’s Go-to-Market Strategy and Operations leadership.

Forecasting & Analytics. Du unterstützt Einkaufs- und Bestandsplanung, Umsatz-Forecasts und Kohortenanalysen mit Modellen, die der Realität standhalten – und lieferst dem Führungsteam die Analysen, auf denen große Entscheidungen ruhen.

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Data-/BI-Rollen im E-Commerce- oder D2C-Umfeld – idealerweise dort, wo hohe Werbebudgets im Spiel waren  Du hast schon mal einen modernen Data Stack aufgebaut oder maßgeblich verantwortet (z. B. jobs.description:
About the team

The Value Proposition & New Benefits team owns what our core value proposition for subscription should be, and the new benefits that bring it to life. We sit within the wider Subscription EMEA org, whose vision is to create the world's leading membership programme in local commerce, delivering unprecedented value and a world-class experience to members.

About the role

We're looking for a Strategy & Operations Manager to own strategy and execution for new benefits within Subscription. This is a hybrid strategy/build/run role: you'll define what to launch, then work cross-functionally to get it shipped and measure whether it's working. You'll be expected to move fluidly between strategic thinking and hands-on execution - this is not a role where strategy stops at a slide deck.  Typical problems you'll solve:

What new benefits should we launch for Subscription - which ideas are worth pursuing, and what's the business case for each?

How do we prioritise and sequence a pipeline of benefit ideas against limited engineering, design, and operational capacity?

How do we define success for a new benefit before launch - what does a good outcome look like, and what would tell us to kill it?

Once live, how is a benefit actually performing - impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and member satisfaction - against its cost to serve, and what does that tell us to do next?

How do we take a benefit from a small pilot to a scaled, steady-state feature, and what needs to be true operationally for that to work?

What you'll be doing

Own the strategy and roadmap  for new benefits within Subscription - build the analysis, the business case, and the plan, and drive it through to execution.

Cross-functional delivery  - partner with Product, Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and Finance to take benefit ideas from concept to launch, without formal authority over any of them.

Build and prioritise the benefit pipeline  - evaluate a stream of ideas (experiential, use-case specific, or otherwise), size their potential impact and cost, and decide what's worth building next.

Track ongoing performance  - maintain visibility into each live benefit's impact on acquisition, retention, frequency, and satisfaction against its cost to serve, flagging when something needs attention.

Scale what works  - take benefits from small pilots to steady-state features, defining the operating model, reporting cadence, and processes needed to run them sustainably.

Bring outside-in perspective  - track what Uber One, DashPass, Wolt+, Just Eat and Amazon Prime are doing with membership benefits, and translate what's relevant into Deliveroo's context.

Communicate to senior stakeholders  - write clear strategy documents and present recommendations, trade-offs, and results to leadership.

🛡️  About this role.  The role carries two things at once. You own security engineering directly and hands-on. You build the security function around it as we grow. At YGO a pod lead is a squad leader and a spokesperson, close to the work and close to the client, rather than a full-time manager. You will not stop being an engineer.  The work is broad. You might review source code in the morning, investigate an endpoint alert after lunch and help design a new authentication flow the next day. You identify the highest-risk problems, decide what happens first and execute.  We serve major travel enterprises and we have enterprise commitments going live from the start of 2027. Security is a condition of that business, not a layer added afterwards.

🧑‍💻 What you'll own

Application security.  Hands-on code and architecture review across our APIs, backend services and internal tooling. Targeted penetration testing to validate issues yourself. Working with engineers on root causes and practical fixes rather than handing over reports. Vulnerability management and the external penetration tests we commission

Detection and response.  Knowing we are under attack while it is happening and what happens next. Alerting, intrusion detection, incident process and the on-call path

Cloud and platform hardening.  Access control, network boundaries, secrets management, containers and the deployment pipeline. Security through the SDLC: CI/CD, repositories and dependencies

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic Fellows Program overview

The Anthropic Fellows Program is designed to foster AI research and engineering talent. We provide funding and mentorship to promising technical talent - regardless of previous experience.

Fellows will primarily use external infrastructure (e.g. open-source models, public APIs) to work on an empirical project aligned with our research priorities, with the goal of producing a public output (e.g. a paper submission). In one of our earlier cohorts, over 80% of fellows produced papers. We run multiple cohorts of Fellows each year and review applications on a rolling basis.

This page is specific to one of the Anthropic Fellows workstreams; see also the main Anthropic Fellows posting.

Apply at the bottom of this page. We are accepting applications on a rolling basis for the next cohort expected to start in January 2027. In some circumstances, we can accommodate fellows starting outside the usual cohort timelines — please note in your application if the January 2027 start date doesn't work for you.

What to expect

  • 4 months of full-time research
  • Direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers
  • Access to a shared workspace (in either Berkeley, California or London, UK)
  • Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community
  • Weekly stipend of 3,850 USD / 2,310 GBP / 4,300 CAD + benefits (these vary by country)
  • Funding for compute (~$15k/month) and other research expenses

Interview process

The interview process will include an initial application & reference check, technical assessments & interviews, and a research discussion.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

jobs.title: Broker Development Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.  We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.  We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

THE ROLE

Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:

Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel.

A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success.

Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets.

Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential.

Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors.

Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance.

Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business.

Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives.

jobs.title: Resourcing & Associate Manager
jobs.description:
Resourcing & Associate Manager

Location:  Our offices are in Central London

Defence/SC Clearance Requirements:

SC clearance is required for our customer facing teams. You do not need active SC clearance as we will undertake checks upon you joining, but you must be eligible to pass SC clearance. DV clearance may be required for certain roles, so the ability/willingness to pass DV clearance is advantageous but not essential.

About Cloudscaler

Cloudscaler is a rapidly growing cloud consultancy. We partner with ambitious enterprise and public sector customers to design, build, operate, and support secure, governed cloud platforms that meet the highest regulatory and industry standards.  We are scaling deliberately. Our revenue ambition depends on deploying the right people onto the right work quickly, and on making disciplined use of our capacity. This role is central to that.

The opportunity

This is a new role at the heart of how Cloudscaler resources delivery. You will own the day-to-day matching of our people to client work across our enterprise and growth accounts, and you will build and run a pool of trusted associates that gives us flexible capacity when we need it.  The role turns two of our core operating policies, the Bench Management Policy and the Utilisation & Time Recording Policy, into everyday practice. You will work alongside Engine Room leadership to keep bench colleagues productively deployed, and you will bring an AI-first mindset to a set of tasks that are currently manual. The ambition is a faster, fairer, more transparent resourcing process, run with less administrative overhead.  You will report to the Chief Consulting Officer and work closely with Engagement Managers, Delivery Managers, the Engine Room, the CRO function, and People operations. This is a build role. You will shape the process, not just follow it.

Responsibilities and outcomes

Resource matching and assignment

jobs.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.  Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.  Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.  We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

9fin has built one of the most comprehensive datasets in credit and debt markets: news, financials, cap tables, instrument data, legal documents, and ESG analysis. Today, most clients access that data through

9fin.com  . But a large and growing segment of the market wants to consume our data programmatically to power firm-level workflows at scale: a negative news signal triggers an automated credit review, updated financials trigger a portfolio rebalance, a covenant keyword triggers a sanctions flag.

These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. They need APIs, data feeds, and cloud-native delivery through platforms like Snowflake. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey.

The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy. You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors. You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data. The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer).

You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Your primary focus is hunting new business opportunities, building sales pipeline, and driving growth within the SMB sector. You are also responsible for upselling into the existing account base, leveraging our Extended Access Management platform. You will own a specific geographical region or country within the EMEA market.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

This is a remote opportunity within the UK.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

2+ years of SaaS sales experience, preferably in security with a focus on SMB or Mid Market accounts OR a top performing BDR with outbound experience and success ready to step up.

Fluent in German; written and spoken

Experience owning a geographical territory or country within EMEA.

Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and KPIs.

Experience upselling & cross-selling to both new customers and across a book of business

Solid skills in:

Prospecting, pipeline building, acco

jobs.title: Machine Learning Fellow - Human Frontier Collective (US)
jobs.description:
About the Collective

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think.
We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including SciPredict, PropensityBench, and Professional Reasoning Benchmark.

Why join the HFC

HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team.

  • Join a unique and exclusive expert network: You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions.
  • Participate in AI/ML projects: Beyond the collective network, you’ll be regularly invited to work on high-impact projects with Scale AI and its affiliated lab and platform: building AI safety and policy guardrails, helping models understand real-world deep learning workflows by designing, reviewing, and optimizing PyTorch models, evaluating complex ML code and AI-generated implementations for efficiency and correctness, and more.
  • Co-author selected research publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition.

Who should apply

  • Background: PhD, or postdoctoral research experience, in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field; or senior industry experience in Machine Learning or a related field.
  • Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and MLOps tools (Docker) and LLM frameworks (LangChain) is a plus.
  • Professional Mindset: Detail-oriented, innovative thinker with a passion for applied AI research and a commitment to collaboration.

How it works

  • Duration: This is a fully remote opportunity with no fixed end date; engagements continue as long as there's mutual interest. This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement.
  • Work authorization:

jobs.title: Product Designer, Evals & Prompts
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Prompts spec out what Claude does. Evals measure whether it did. The Product Prompt and Eval Design team does both for product design: the system prompt that greets a new user, the tool descriptions that decide whether Claude searches, the instructions that keep a slide deck from tipping into slop, and the evals that test all of it. The point is to keep the model and the product aligned with what users expect, what the product strategy calls for, and what safety requires, on every surface and through every model launch.

This role is a foundational member of that work on the eval side: building the evals that check the prompts, the harness that runs them, and the tools that let designers do this work themselves. It sits on the Product Prompt and Eval Design team in Product Design, works day to day with the team's surface owners and the engineers in each product team, and pairs per surface with the prompt engineering team at model releases.

Key responsibilities

  • Write and revise the prompts behind Claude's tools, features, and behaviors on a product surface; test the surface, turn findings into prompt fixes, ship them, and confirm the prompt users get is the one intended
  • Build the graders that prove a prompt fix and rerun on the next model; turn designers' hand-run rubrics into automated evals, then read transcripts for what the eval missed
  • Build visual, low-code eval tools designers can use without an engineer: assemble a comparison set from real transcripts, turn a plain-English rubric into a grader, compare prompt variants across models side by side, and read results in the tool rather than a notebook
  • Watch designers use those tools and make them simpler
  • Support model releases: test each surface against the new model, write prompt fixes and migrations, and write prompts for features launching with it, so the surface owner's call has numbers behind it
  • Stand up and scale the eval harness: build the test environment that exercises our 50 to 100 tools with trustworthy settings, keep evals green across models, and call whether a regression is the harness or the model
  • Package what prompting can't fix for training, with the eval attached: graders for crisp behaviors, human-feedback questions and good/bad pairs for fuzzy ones like writing quality

Minimum qualifications

  • Production-quality Python
  • Experience building and maintaining evaluation pipelines for LLM products: graders, rubrics, comparison sets, regression

在研发（R&D）团队中担任战斗游戏设计师。你将与其他设计师、艺术家和工程师密切协作，优化和迭代以玩家为中心的设计，致力于创造突破性的游戏体验。由于团队规模仍较小，该岗位需要大量实操工作，亲自创建和调校战斗系统/机制。你应能适应目标与限制主要由团队驱动的不确定性环境，同时适应大大小小的变更作为设计流程的日常一部分。

职责：

  • 设计、实现并改进战斗机制与系统，使其令玩家满意并提升对游戏概念的信心。

  • 在所处游戏类型中探索创新战斗设计方案，提出多种可行的设计与解决方案，清晰说明各种方案之间的权衡与风险。

  • 利用快速原型与游戏测试验证设计方案的可行性。

  • 编写清晰的设计文档，确保非设计人员也能评估与实现相关内容。

  • 与设计团队及其他跨职能团队协作，共同打造出色的整体游戏体验。积极配合、听取反馈并不断迭代，以实现最高质量的产品。

岗位要求：

  • 至少 3 年专业游戏设计工作经验。

  • 至少 2 年 Unreal 引擎使用经验，熟练使用技能编辑器、关卡编辑器、GAS 系统及蓝图。

  • 在以下领域至少精通一项：战斗机制、战斗手感、战斗 AI、角色控制 / 摄像机 / 操作系统。

  • 能够流利使用中文普通话交流。

加分项：

  • 在至少一款已发行游戏中，熟练使用某款游戏引擎的脚本编程。

  • 能流利使用英语进行口头与书面交流。

在此岗位中，你将通过精湛的专业技能、积极的协作精神和以玩家愉悦体验为导向的决策获得成功。我们将重点参考你过往的学习经历、工作经验及你与游戏的个人关系。如果你具有强烈的玩家同理心，并真正关心玩家的游戏体验，这份工作可能正是为你量身打造的！

jobs.title: Game Designer, System - Unpublished R&D Product (Contract)

  • 配合研发、美术等协作团队，确保方案落地还原度和功能流畅，持续推动体验打磨和流程优化。
  • 收集数据、分析玩家反馈，系统性评估和优化设计内容，推动城池发展和核心系统可持续进化。

  • 具备出色的沟通与团队协作能力，积极推动方案高效落地。

加分项

  • 有城市建设、成长模拟、策略或重社交手游的玩法及系统策划经验。
  • 具备大型成长/经济系统模型搭建、数据调优或A/B测试实际经验。
  • 有国际化项目、海外用户洞察或多文化团队协作能力。
  • 能撰写或阅读英文系统策划文档。

我们的福利

我们倡导健康平衡的工作与生活，提供有竞争力的带薪休假、灵活办公方式及多元保险福利。团队关注多元与包容性氛围，鼓励创新协作，让每一位成员都能获得成长和成就。与我们一起，见证并驱动一款创新大作的诞生吧！

jobs.description:
Riot Games was founded in 2006 by gamers who believe that putting players first can create truly great games. Since launching League of Legends in 2009, we’ve grown into a global leader in games, serving millions of players every day. Players are at the heart of everything we do, and we continuously evolve our experiences to better serve them.

We’re looking for humble, driven professionals who take play seriously and bring a strong sense of ownership to their craft. You’re curious, collaborative, and not afraid to challenge conventions in pursuit of better player experiences.

That's where you come in.

  • Fluent in Mandarin.

  • Experience owning features or systems through a full development lifecycle (concept → launch → iteration).
  • Proven ability to collaborate across multiple disciplines and stakeholders.
  • Fluency in English.

jobs.description:
Company Introduction

Founded in 2006 by passionate entrepreneurial gamers, Riot Games centers its game development philosophy on player experience. The studio debuted League of Legends in 2009, which earned widespread critical acclaim and grew into the world’s most-played video game with over 100 million monthly active players. The global player community forms the core foundation of Riot’s business, driving continuous iteration and optimization of in-game player experience.

Role Overview

Riot Visual Designers seek to craft the best player experiences through their knowledge of graphic design, interactivity, layout, typography, color theory, and illustration. Designers collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams and act as both artistic and design problem solvers. They understand players and ask questions about the what, who and how when solving for visual communication design challenges.

As a Visual Designer for Wild Rift, you embody this approach as the execution core of the Publishing Art team. You deliver high-quality visual assets across all player touchpoints, partner with cross-functional teams to bring campaign visions to life, and ensure visual excellence in every deliverable. This role focuses on hands-on production and design implementation, serving as a key driver in translating high-level brand strategy into impactful visual campaigns to delight global players.

This role is based in Shanghai, China.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Visual Execution & Production: Independently execute end-to-end advanced visual design production (Visual Identity/social assets/event materials) to deliver high-aesthetic global publishing content.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work seamlessly with motion, illustration, and localization teams to unify visual messaging and ensure smooth, efficient creative workflows.
  • Vendor & Asset Support: Assist in reviewing outsourced deliverables and provide precise, actionable visual feedback in line with Riot’s quality bar.
  • Resource Stewardship: Manage and organize scalable visual asset libraries; contribute to the maintenance of standardized design production files.

jobs.title: 中国区周边消费品业务销售运营经理 (Contract)
jobs.description:
拳头游戏（Riot Games）由一群富有创业精神的硬核玩家于2006年创立。我们坚信“玩家优先”的理念能够造就伟大的游戏。我们的首款游戏《英雄联盟》（League of Legends）于2009年发行，赢得了业界与玩家的广泛赞誉。如今，它已成为全球最受欢迎的电子游戏之一，月活跃玩家超过一亿。

在拳头游戏，玩家是我们一切工作的核心。我们正在寻找谦逊、充满雄心且目光敏锐的专业人才，你们不仅要对游戏满怀热情，还要敢于打破常规。作为回报，我们将为你提供充满挑战且全力支持的成长环境。

关于该职位 作为业务运营经理，你将直接向消费品业务运营负责人汇报，并成为我们在B2B商业版图上的核心驱动力。你将扮演至关重要的桥梁角色，将拳头游戏的高品质IP周边与我们的战略线下及B2B合作伙伴紧密连接。

你的核心使命主要分为三个方面：积极拓展B2B网络，获取全新的大客户；深入管理并发展现有的战略合作关系；全盘负责我们线下体验式零售活动的商业闭环（如电竞快闪店和粉丝嘉年华）。你是一位谈判专家和关系建立大师，深知在游戏IP领域，成功的B2B战略绝不仅仅是单纯的“卖货”，而是在现实世界中为我们的玩家创造触手可及、高品质的体验触点。

核心职责

  • 大客户拓展（B2B商务拓展）： 发掘、宣讲并引入新的战略级B2B合作伙伴、线下零售连锁店及垂直领域经销商。开拓与拳头游戏高端品牌定位相符的全新线下销售渠道。
  • 现有KA覆盖与增长： 维护并深化与现有大客户（如腾讯、大型线下零售网络）的合作关系。负责商业条款谈判、管控批发利润率，并确保健康的库存消化率，从而达成年度B2B营收目标。
  • 线下活动与体验式零售： 主导线下周边体验的端到端商业落地。包括在LPL总决赛、VCT巡回赛、拳头游戏周年庆及专属快闪店等重大节点中，全面管理现场销售运营、库存把控及合作伙伴协调。
  • B2B战略与规划： 与销售运营负责人紧密合作，制定年度和季度的B2B销售策略，确保其与我们更广泛的DTP（玩家直营）/电商目标相辅相成。
  • 合作伙伴营销与联合推广： 与外部KA伙伴及内部营销团队协同，设计定制化的零售营销活动，确保我们的实体产品在合作伙伴的生态系统中获得最大化的曝光。
  • 数据追踪与汇报： 监控B2B渠道健康度、合作伙伴合规性以及线下活动的投资回报率（ROI）。提供定期的销售预测与具备实操性的洞察分析，以持续优化线下业务。

任职要求

  • 本科及以上学历。
  • 8年以上B2B销售、大客户管理或渠道商务拓展经验；拥有消费品、潮玩或娱乐IP行业经验者优先。
  • 扎实的BD业绩： 能够证明自己具备开拓新市场、谈判复杂分销合同，以及从零搭建盈利性B2B渠道的能力。
  • 线下活动运营： 具备线下零售运营、快闪店或大型活动/展会商业展台操盘的实战经验。
  • 利益相关方管理： 出色的跨部门/跨企业沟通技巧，能够影响并管理顶级经销商以及内部跨职能团队（如供应链、营销、IP授权等）。
  • 敏捷性与问题解决能力： 适应快节奏的工作环境，乐于挽起袖子亲力亲为，能够迅速解决线下活动现场的突发运营问题。
  • 沟通能力： 具备出色的中英文口头与书面沟通及商业谈判能力。

加分项（期待条件）

  • 在中国核心的线下潮玩/收藏品零售商、书店、院线或生活方式分销网络中拥有深厚的人脉资源与现有合作关系。
  • 对游戏充满真挚的热爱，并对《英雄联盟》、《无畏契约》（VALORANT）或《云顶之弈》（TFT）的玩家文化有深刻理解。

在这个岗位上，你的成功将源于精湛的专业技能、团队协作精神，以及始终将“给玩家带来惊喜”置于首位的决策力。我们不仅会考量你的过往学业与经验，还会看重你与游戏的个人羁绊。如果你具备玩家同理心，并深切关怀玩家的体验，这就是为你量身定制的角色！

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Partner Sales Manager for Systems Integrators at Anthropic, you'll own a portfolio of global and regional SI partners and be responsible for the revenue they drive. This role sits at the intersection of partnerships and sales — you'll build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders at firms like Accenture, Deloitte, and PwC, and align on joint go-to-market plans. Your main stakeholders will be sales leaders at Anthropic - helping them to land and expand enterprise deals where partner involvement is the difference between winning and not.
